source.author: verg
source.text: Panditur interea domus omnipotentis Olympi, conciliumque vocat divom pater atque hominum rex sideream in sedem, terras unde arduus omnis castraque Dardanidum aspectat populosque Latinos.
source.text_original: Panditur interea domus omnipotentis Olympi, / conciliumque vocat divom pater atque hominum rex / sideream in sedem, terras unde arduus omnis / castraque Dardanidum aspectat populosque Latinos.
source.text_english: Meanwhile the house of almighty Olympus is opened, and the father of the gods and king of men calls a council to the starry abode, from which, towering high, he looks out over all the lands and the camp of the Dardanidae and the Latin peoples.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nostris modo concitus ausis aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens concilium.
reuse.text_original: nostris modo concitus ausis / aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens / concilium.
reuse.text_english: Just now, stirred by our daring, behold Neptune calls the sea gods and the great council.
